```{r}
mod_dir <- "../data/g2g_data/g2g_flows_sim_extrasites/20260724_102214"

file <- list.files(mod_dir)
mod <- read.time.series(file, mod_dir, output = "model")
# obs <- read.time.series(file, dir, output = "observed")


obs_dir <- "../data/g2g_data/g2g_flows_sim_extrasites/obs"
obs_dirs <- list.files(obs_dir, recursive = TRUE)
flow_files <- obs_dirs[ !grepl("G2G", obs_dirs)]
flow_files <- flow_files[ grepl("Obs", flow_files) | grepl("Rated", flow_files)]

years <- c("2018", "2019", "2020", "2021")

obs <- list()
for (year in years){
  # obs_1 <- fread(file.path(obs_dir, flow_files[grepl(year, flow_files)][1]))
  # obs_2 <- fread(file.path(obs_dir, flow_files[grepl(year, flow_files)][2]))
  ob_year <- lapply( file.path(obs_dir, flow_files[grepl(year, flow_files)]), function(x) fread(x))
  obs_comb <- cbindlist(ob_year)
  setnames(obs_comb, as.character(unlist(obs_comb[1])))
  obs_comb <- obs_comb[-1,]
  obs_comb <- obs_comb[-1,]
  setnames(obs_comb, 1, "DATE_TIME")
  obs_comb[obs_comb < - 999] <- NA
  obs[[year]] <- obs_comb
}

obs <- rbindlist(obs)

names(year_data) <- years
```
